description: This file defines a utility class 'Assert' with static methods for argument validation, including null checks, type checks, and emptiness checks, primarily used for input validation in Java code.

classes.name: Assert
classes.description: A final utility class providing static methods for argument validation, such as null checks, type assertions, and emptiness checks.

methods.name: isAssignableTo
methods.description: Checks if an argument can be assigned to a specified class, throws IllegalArgumentException if not.

methods.name: isInstanceOf
methods.description: Checks if an argument is an instance of a specified class, throws IllegalArgumentException if not.

methods.name: isInstanceOf (varargs)
methods.description: Checks if an argument is an instance of any of the specified classes, throws IllegalArgumentException if not.

methods.name: isNotInstanceOf
methods.description: Checks if an argument is not an instance of a specified class, throws IllegalArgumentException if it is.

methods.name: isNotInstanceOf (varargs)
methods.description: Checks if an argument is not an instance of any of the specified classes, throws IllegalArgumentException if it is.

methods.name: notEmpty (String)
methods.description: Checks if a String argument is not null and not empty, throws IllegalArgumentException if empty.

methods.name: notEmpty (Map)
methods.description: Checks if a Map argument is not null and not empty, throws IllegalArgumentException if empty.

methods.name: notEmpty (Collection)
methods.description: Checks if a Collection argument is not null and not empty, throws IllegalArgumentException if empty.

methods.name: notEmpty (Array)
methods.description: Checks if an array argument is not null and has length greater than zero, throws IllegalArgumentException if empty.

methods.name: notNull (varargs)
methods.description: Checks multiple arguments for null, expects pairs of argument name and argument object.

methods.name: notNull
methods.description: Checks if a single argument is not null, throws IllegalArgumentException if null.
